description: The Waag in Gouda is a Dutch-classicist brick weigh house in the north wall of the Markt, with a hipped roof, stone-framed windows, and a sculpted pediment. The paving in front is empty. The sky is overcast, about 12.8°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h. The Gothic Stadhuis stands free in the middle of the same square and is behind the camera, not in this frame. No lettering is readable.
